title_ar: الشيخ الددو يلقي سلسلة محاضرات في دورة المعاملات الإسلامية المعاصرة بالمركز
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers a Series of Lectures in the Centre's Course on Contemporary Islamic Transactions
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا سلسلة محاضرات في المدرج الكبير بمركز تكوين العلماء في إطار دورة تكوينية كانت مقررة لطلاب المركز حول موضوع: "المعاملات الإسلامية المعاصرة"، خلال الفترة الممتدة من 1 إلى 12 يناير 2014م.
تهدف دورة المعاملات إلى تكوين الطلاب على الصيغ الحديثة للمعاملات وتدريبهم على الربط بين المعلومة النظرية في الفقه وواقع المعاملات في البنوك والمصارف الإسلامية، وما يدور في الحياة اليومية بين البائع والمشتري من صيغ تتجدد وتتشعب من وقت لآخر..
يُصاحب هذه الدورة توزيع مذكرة للدورة من إعداد الشيخ الددو تتناول جميع عناصر وأهداف الدورة لتبسيط الشرح على الطلاب ومسايرة دروس وحلقات الدورة.
وقد تم إلقاء محاضرتيْن - حتى الآن – تناولتا تعاريف بعض مصطلحات المعاملات وبعض الصيغ الشائعة لهذه المعاملات.
وتتخلل هذه الدروس نقاشات علمية وردود من الشيخ الددو على استشكالات الطلاب واستفساراتهم حول المواضيع التي تم تناولها.
ويواكب موقع الشيخ الددو بث هذه الدورة بثا مباشرا على "قناة دوويات" في اليوتيوب، كما ستتم معالجتها ونشرها على الموقع في وقت لاحق – إن شاء الله- .
body_en:
His eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, delivered a series of lectures in the great lecture hall of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, as part of a training course set for the Centre's students on the subject of "Contemporary Islamic Transactions (muʿāmalāt)", over the period running from 1 to 12 January 2014.
The course on transactions aims to train the students in the modern forms of transactions, and to school them in connecting theoretical knowledge in jurisprudence (fiqh) with the reality of transactions in the banks and the Islamic financial institutions, and with what goes on in daily life between seller and buyer in forms that are renewed and that ramify from one time to another…
Accompanying this course is the distribution of a course handbook prepared by Sheikh al-Dedew, covering all the elements and aims of the course, so as to simplify the exposition for the students and to keep pace with the course's lessons and sessions.
Two lectures have been delivered so far, treating the definitions of some of the terms used in transactions, and some of the widespread forms of these transactions.
These lessons are interspersed with scholarly discussions, and with replies from Sheikh al-Dedew to the students' difficulties and queries about the subjects treated.
Sheikh al-Dedew's website is following this course with a live broadcast on the "Dedewiyyat" channel on YouTube; it will also be processed and published on the site at a later time — God willing.

flags.context: the live broadcast of the course
flags.note: دوويات is an unvocalised coinage from the Sheikh's own name (al-Dedew), roughly 'Dedew-ana', the collected Dedew material. The romanisation is a guess at the vowels; the channel's own spelling should be used if the Sheikh's office can supply it. No channel link is in the record.

muʿāmalāt is glossed 'transactions'. 'Financial transactions' would be narrower than the Arabic, which covers dealings between people generally, though the course as described is plainly about finance and banking.

translator_notes: An announcement of a course, not a text of it. None of the lectures described is in this record; the content was to be 'processed and published later'. Must not be displayed as a lecture by the Sheikh.

البنوك والمصارف الإسلامية: بنوك and مصارف are near-synonyms in modern usage and the phrase may mean simply 'the Islamic banks'. Rendered 'the banks and the Islamic financial institutions' so as not to collapse a possible distinction between conventional and Islamic institutions, which is the point of the course.
The source's '..' and '–' are the site's own punctuation; kept as ellipses and dashes.
